name: Planning contracts
description: Offline planning identity, feasibility, recovery, and failure-boundary cases.

cases.name: Ordinary non-Catalog trip
cases.description: Legacy travel remains behaviorally available without Catalog context.

cases.name: Catalog route trip
cases.description: Explicit Catalog route context completes through the standard planning path.

cases.name: Mandatory Anchor preserved
cases.description: Verified mandatory identity remains present end to end.

cases.name: Mandatory result deduplicated
cases.description: An already returned Provider POI is not duplicated during mandatory injection.
cases.source: M1B-2 exact Provider identity dedup contract.

cases.name: Waiting user and resume
cases.description: A waiting run resumes without losing its frozen request.

cases.name: Valid multi-stop route
cases.description: A road-feasible multi-stop schedule passes deterministic validation.

cases.name: Valid meal fallback
cases.description: Progressive meal discovery produces route-feasible coverage.

cases.name: Mandatory binding missing
cases.description: A missing verified binding is surfaced rather than guessed.
cases.attack: Remove all bindings for a mandatory Anchor.

cases.name: Candidate binding only
cases.description: Candidate identity cannot satisfy mandatory runtime identity.
cases.attack: Replace a verified binding with candidate status.

cases.name: Provider ID mismatch
cases.description: Same-name POI with a different Provider ID is rejected.
cases.attack: Substitute a same-name POI with another external ID.

cases.name: Planner drops mandatory POI
cases.description: Mandatory-anchor recall detects a dropped mandatory identity.
cases.attack: Remove the mandatory Provider identity from generated days.

cases.name: Road duration exceeds gap
cases.description: An impossible scheduled gap is rejected by route feasibility.
cases.attack: Set road duration above the scheduled transition gap.

cases.name: Huge meal detour
cases.description: A meal option with excessive route detour is infeasible.
cases.attack: Use a meal candidate outside the permitted route detour.

cases.name: Provider error
cases.description: A Provider failure is explicit and does not fabricate POIs.
